poems.title: DJ Turn Me Up
poems.note: a converted townhouse — the house party (the shoot's own neighbourhood)

set_pieces.name: DJ drops in
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · A DJ drops in — “Dj turn me up, please”

set_pieces.name: Eyes wide shut at the mic
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · B Eyes wide shut at the mic — “With eyes wide shut”

set_pieces.name: Ghosts in the speaker mesh
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · C Ghosts in the speaker mesh — “ghosts whispering unfolded dilutions”

set_pieces.name: A thousand light years, into the red
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · D A thousand light years, into the red — “i walked 1,000 light years”

set_pieces.name: Wedding bands and the boxed home
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · E Wedding bands and the boxed home — “wedding bands diverging”

set_pieces.name: Eleven years in daisy petals
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · F Eleven years in daisy petals — “years, eleven years”

set_pieces.name: Rain, fog, dim lights, then chin high
set_pieces.line: 7 DJ TURN ME UP · G Rain, fog, dim lights, then chin high — “heavy rain, or frontal fog”

foundry_refs.desc: Open diary glows on turntable platter.
Literal visual match: Young boy in red hoodie gazing out rain-streaked roadside diner window at overcast highway.
foundry_refs.line: I have a love story to tell — of ghosts, whispering unfolded dilutions, birthed in purity, and dying in the vineyards of sun-soaked evergreen fields, unnourished.

foundry_refs.desc: Wooden risers creak under absent voices, hymnals closed tight.
